en.files.defaultDir: Default directory (entered when opening this workspace)
en.flow.syncPaths: Sync scope (optional, empty = global default / whole tree)
en.picker.errNameBad: Folder name cannot contain / or \, nor be . or ..
en.settings.defaultSyncExclude: Default sync excludes for new workspaces
en.settings.defaultSyncMaxBytes: Default sync size limit (GiB, empty = built-in 2 GiB)
en.settings.defaultSyncPaths: Default sync scope for new workspaces (comma or newline separated)
en.settings.desc: Manage Remote-SSH connection profiles (SSH key or password authentication).
en.settings.empty: No connection profiles yet. Add one below.
en.settings.guardsHint: If the integrated terminal cannot start, put the absolute path of node here (issue #23). The other two control whether the agent's write/edit is pushed to the remote (issue #24).
en.settings.name: Name
en.settings.nodePath: Absolute path of node (nodePath; empty = auto-resolve)
en.settings.syncScopeHint: Sync only the sub-paths you need instead of a whole-tree tar. This matters for workspaces whose remote path is ~ — a whole-tree sync is refused by the size sentinel first (issue #28). Empty = whole tree.
en.settings.wbError: Make it visible to the model (tool error, recommended)
en.settings.wbLog: Log only (do not disturb the model)
en.settings.writeBackFreshness: Check the remote before pushing (skip + report if it changed remotely; recommended on)
en.settings.wsSyncExclude: Sync excludes (comma or newline separated, e.g. data/, *.log)
en.settings.wsSyncMaxBytes: Sync size limit (GiB, empty = default 2 GiB)
en.settings.wsSyncPaths: Sync scope (comma or newline separated, e.g. .dsh; empty = whole tree)
en.settings.wsWriteBack: Enable write-back for this workspace (agent write/edit syncs to the remote)
en.settings.wsWriteBackExclude: Write-back excludes (comma or newline separated, e.g. _patch/, *.log, wbdeep/**)
en.term.emptyHint: Create a terminal from the profile above to operate the remote environment.
en.term.inputPlaceholder: Type a command and press Enter…
en.term.title: Terminal {id}
